slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The required area for each month must be met exactly, or is it acceptable to rent more area than required in a given month (i.e., the rented area in a month can be at least the required area)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly required area must be met exactly or whether excess is allowed.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask for or confirm the optimization objective, such as minimizing total rental cost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and P0 objective and P1 contract-diversity slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several structural details and correctly resolved exact demand satisfaction, but it failed to ask about the optimization objective, contract-length diversity, full-term contract coverage, or any cap on distinct contracts, and it became stuck repeating the same unresolved question without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
